boot.title: We couldn't load Prompt Battle
boot.message: Check your connection and try again.

landing.heading: Cities
landing.intro: Players arrive with their city's QR code. This page is for testing.

announce.lobby: You're in the waiting room. Wait for the round to start.
announce.roundClosed: Round closed! The AI is scoring.

connection.lost: No connection to the game. Retrying…

join.heading: Join the game in {{city}}
join.privacy: Use an alias. Don't write personal data. Your prompts are sent to third-party AI services to generate and evaluate images.
join.kickedHint: If it was a mistake, you can join again with another nickname.

lobby.claimHint: Keep it: if you make the podium, you'll show it to claim your prize.
lobby.wait: Wait for the round to start
lobby.waitDetail: This screen changes by itself when it starts. Meanwhile, watch the projector.

round.practiceNote: It doesn't count toward the score.

editor.label: Describe the image
editor.placeholder: E.g. a colorful chiva bus in the rain, at night
editor.duplicate: You already generated this exact prompt: with the round's seed it would give the same image. Change something to try another.
editor.duplicateOf: It's the same prompt as attempt {{number}}: it would give the same image. Change something to generate another.

generate.label: Generate
generate.busy: Wait for your image to finish before generating another one.
generate.noAttempts: You've used all {{max}} attempts. Pick below the image you want to submit.

status.failed: Attempt {{number}} failed: it didn't use an attempt
status.late: Attempt {{number}} arrived late: it didn't use an attempt

announce.blocked: Your prompt was blocked. Try another idea; it didn't use an attempt.
announce.failed: We couldn't generate the image. It didn't use an attempt; try again.
announce.late: The image finished after the round closed and doesn't count.

gallery.heading: Your attempts
gallery.empty: No images yet. Write a prompt and press Generate.
gallery.autoEntry: Pick the one you want to submit. If you don't, we'll submit your latest image.
gallery.changeHint: You can change your choice until the round closes.

attempt.title: Attempt {{number}}
attempt.selectedAnnounce: You picked attempt {{number}}. You can change it until the round closes.
attempt.lateMessage: It finished after the round closed, so it doesn't count.

closed.practice: That was the practice round: it doesn't count toward the score. Get ready for the next one!
closed.grace: Your image was already on its way: if it finishes in the next few seconds, it counts.
closed.noEntry: You didn't submit an image this round.

waiting.scored: The AI has finished scoring. Watch the screen: what's next is coming soon.
waiting.mini: Watch the screen: this round's top 3 is being revealed.
waiting.finalScoring: The AI is preparing the final podium…
waiting.podium: Watch the screen: the top 5 of {{city}} is being revealed. Your result will show up here at the end.
waiting.stayHere: Keep this screen open: it updates by itself.

final.podium: You're on the podium! Show your code {{claimCode}}
final.noRank: You didn't submit any images this time, so you have no rank.

stage.title: Stage
stage.placeholder: The projector view is coming soon.

admin.title: Admin
admin.heading: Admin console
admin.placeholder: This is where you'll control your city's rounds. Coming soon.

errors.NICKNAME_INVALID: Your nickname must be {{min}}–{{max}} characters: letters, digits, spaces, _ or -.
errors.NICKNAME_TAKEN: That nickname is already taken in your city. Try another one.
errors.NICKNAME_BLOCKED: That nickname isn't allowed at this event. Pick another one.
errors.CITY_NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find the city “{{city}}”. Check the link or scan the QR code again.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session is no longer valid. Please join again.
errors.PLAYER_KICKED: An admin removed you from the game.
errors.ROUND_NOT_OPEN: The round isn't open right now.
errors.GENERATION_IN_FLIGHT: Wait for your current image to finish before generating another one.
errors.NO_ATTEMPTS_LEFT: You've used all {{max}} attempts for this round.
errors.PROMPT_BLOCKED: That prompt isn't allowed at this event. Try another idea.
errors.ATTEMPT_NOT_SELECTABLE: You can only submit a finished image from the open round.
errors.GENERATION_FAILED: We couldn't generate the image. Try again.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: That action isn't available in the current phase.
errors.ROUND_LOCKED: This round has already started in a city and can't be changed.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: You're going too fast. Wait {{retryAfterSec}} s and try again.
errors.RESET_NOT_CONFIRMED: Type RESET to confirm the reset.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.
errors.PREVIEW_NOT_FOUND: That preview no longer exists. Generate a new one.
errors.PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND: Provider “{{providerId}}” doesn't exist or has no key.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: No image provider is available right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.ROUND_NOT_READY: This round's calibration isn't ready yet.
errors.UPLOAD_INVALID: Upload a JPEG or PNG image up to {{maxMb}} MB.
errors.SCORING_FAILED: You can only rescore a round whose scoring failed.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
